title: Supported replay of a retained unconfirmed acceptance-evaluation submission after its evaluator has ended
outcome: A retained unconfirmed evaluation write can be resent once, unchanged, under its original evaluator actor and attempt key, through a supported host route, so that an unknown outcome is settled without a new judgment.
acceptance: A supported host route resends a retained Unconfirmed acceptance-evaluation submission whose evaluator has ended, with its original payload bytes, actor and attempt key unchanged, and settles it to Recorded or to a typed refusal; it never creates a new judgment or a parent-authored verdict.

The route refuses when the stored payload digest differs, when another submission or follow-up for the same evaluator is in flight, or when the submission is already Recorded, and it is idempotent: a repeat after Recorded changes nothing.
Behavioural tests with an Engram fixture cover: a timed-out submission replayed to Recorded, a replay that times out again staying Unconfirmed with the same key, and the refusals above.

completion.summary: Delivered and landed owning-parent recovery for retained Unconfirmed evaluator submissions. Exact original actor, attempt, payload and source are preserved; refusals/duplicate/flight and persistence boundaries are guarded, receipt result and MCP pending projection repairs reviewed.
